description: Add a ball particle trace to record and visualize ball motion path. Positions and velocities are sampled and stored during model run. The trace can be visualized to show particle flow patterns. Use trace commands for subsequent manipulation of particle traces.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('ball trace ...') - Python SDK does not provide trace creation. Use trace commands for manipulation.

keywords.name: id
keywords.description: Identify the ball to trace by its ID (a position vector may be given instead).

examples.description: Create trace for ball 1 (auto-assign trace ID)
Create trace with ID 100 for ball 1
Create trace for ball nearest to position (0,0,5)
Create trace ID 10 for ball nearest to (-2,3,0)

9.0: On the PFC 9.8 builds the trace is created but never sampled: trace export reports an empty list, trace list stays at the origin, and every trace gets ID 0, so address it by name. 9.00 and 7.0 record the path; on 9.8 sample the position with a history or a callback.
